verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference API for coding agents. Its docs cover Fast Apply edits, WarpGrep search, Compact compression and Reflex text classifiers, but nothing shows the product surfacing AI-generated insights or suggestions about a user's own data. Reflexes, which label turns for things like frustration or loops and can compare canary results, are classification primitives a developer would wire into their own system. They are not an in-product insights feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
